script:
-- Carrega o script original
local OriginalScript = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Flee-the-Facility-YAFTFEM-11844"))()

-- Espera o menu ser criado
local function renameMenu()
    local playerGui = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, gui in pairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            for _, frame in pairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                if frame:IsA("TextLabel") and frame.Text == "YAFTFEM" then
                    frame.Text = "mnpv92" -- muda o nome do topo do menu
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Espera alguns segundos para o menu ser carregado
task.wait(2)
renameMenu()
